decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-69901ebd-7fff-a46c-c507-c4362db90d95"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permit, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 (Strategic approach to transport) and T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development).</span></span></p>

<p><span style="white-space: pre; white-space: normal;">	</span></p><p>The proposed works would have an unacceptable impact on the trees on site. Insufficient information has been provided including lack of BS5837(2012) including topographical tree survey with trees and Root Protection Areas marked, an Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement. This is contrary to policy G7 (Trees and woodland) of the London Plan (2021) and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to Hackney Local Plan (LP33) Policy LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) and London Plan (2021) Policy SI2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions).</p>

<p>The proposed works would have an unacceptable impact on biodiversity on site. Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate how a 10% biodiversity net gain will be achieved on the site contrary to policy G6 (Biodiversity and Access to Nature), policy LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation) and Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (inserted by the Environment Act 2021).</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a732132c-7fff-a044-4844-27fa4244d998"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, namely in respect to the basement unit, would fail to provide a high quality standard of accommodation for its occupants. By virtue of its substandard layout and inadequate light, the proposal would comprise a substandard form of residential accommodation, to the detriment of the living conditions of future residents. The development proposal falls contrary to guidance under the National Described Space Standards 2015; policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design led approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan 2021 and Residential Extension and Alterations SPD 2009.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-255a5a68-7fff-0fc3-4ef7-f1a88fdbf1bf"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing need in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with Policies H4 (Delivering affordable housing) and H5 (Threshold approach to applications) of the London Plan (2021), Hackney Local Plan Policies LP12 (Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes), LP13 (Affordable Housing) and NPPF (2024) paragraph 63 and the Hackney S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020).</span></span></p>
description: Erection of a mansard roof, erection of a 3 storey rear extension (basement, ground and first floors) and creation of a front & rear basement lightwell; to facilitate conversion of the property from two to three self contained residential units (1x1 bed, 1x1 bed, 1x3 bed)
